description: ECMAScript number serialization (RFC 8785 section 3.2.2.3) of binary64 values, as [big-endian bits hex, text]. random: the first count finite values from splitmix64 seeded with seed (each output read as binary64 bits; non-finite draws are skipped). edges: zeros, subnormals, max, and the points where the format switches to an exponent.
